# @sharadox/test-web-library

> Playwright helpers + shared e2e suites for Next.js sites.

- /visual-snapshot prepareVisualSnapshot(page, url, { time, step=400 })
- /search-engine-suite describeSearchEngine({ indexable?=true, origin, pages: [{ path, language, heading }], structuredDataTypes, routes? }); STANDARD_ROUTES = sitemap.xml, robots.txt, manifest.webmanifest
- /installability-suite describeInstallability(path) (Chromium CDP Page.getInstallabilityErrors)
- /preference-suite describeLocaleMemory({ browserLocale, automaticPath, switchName, pick: { link, path } }), describeStyleMemory({ path, attribute, switchName, colorScheme, initial, pick: { radio, style } }), describeConsent({ path, dialogName, deny, customize, save, preferences, category, storageKey, expectedGranted })
- Peer: @playwright/test. License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- /browser-environment installBrowserEnvironment({ reducedMotion=false, finePointer=true, dark=true }) (Vitest happy-dom: IntersectionObserver/ResizeObserver stubs, matchMedia, scrollTo, Motion skipAnimations); reportIntersection(isIntersecting=true, filter?); observers
